nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Called by IntakeForm.tsx right after inserting a campaign row (status='pending'). Payload: { campaign_id }. Async. Builds a campaign > ad set > (creative > ad) on Meta, ALL PAUSED, then sets status='paused' + pending_review=true so the dashboard flags it for the agency's launch decision.

nodes.name: Prepare context
nodes.notes: Throws (halts, visible in n8n's execution log) if the row is missing, has no valid ad account, or has no budget. Unlike the Google version this does NOT auto-write status='error' — reset the row manually if a build half-fails. Consider adding an error handler that writes status='error' + error_message.

nodes.name: Create campaign
nodes.notes: Response: { id: '<campaign id>' }. special_ad_categories=[] is required by the API for a normal campaign.

nodes.name: Create ad set
nodes.notes: daily_budget is in the account currency MINOR unit (cents for USD). Response: { id: '<adset id>' }. If Meta rejects the optimization_goal/bid_strategy combo, that's expected tuning work — the agency fixes it in Ads Manager before launch.

nodes.name: Has Page ID?
nodes.notes: No Facebook Page -> can't build a creative or ad. Campaign + ad set are still created (PAUSED); the agency adds a Page and finishes the ad in Ads Manager, or edits the client + rebuilds.

parameters.name: object_story_spec
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ page_id: $('Prepare context').item.json.pageId, link_data: { message: ($('Prepare context').item.json.primaryGoalText || ('Learn more about ' + $('Prepare context').item.json.businessName)).slice(0, 500), link: $('Prepare context').item.json.websiteUrl, name: $('Prepare context').item.json.businessName.slice(0, 40), description: 'Contact us today to get started.', call_to_action: { type: 'LEARN_MORE', value: { link: $('Prepare context').item.json.websiteUrl } } } }) }}

nodes.name: Create creative
nodes.notes: Placeholder link ad with no image (Meta will use the link's preview image, or the agency swaps in real media before launch). Response: { id: '<creative id>' }.

fieldValues.fieldValue: Campaign and ad set created (paused). No Facebook Page on the client, so no ad/creative was built — add a Page ID and finish the ad in Ads Manager, or rebuild.

nodes.name: Notify: needs review
nodes.notes: Replace with your Slack/Email node. The dashboard already flags pending_review campaigns with a violet 'needs launch review' badge.
